cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. We can fix last night's shouting. Tea first, then one honest sentence each.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want tea. I want you to listen without interrupting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Of course. Listening stage. I'll write down anything I want to interrupt with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll be writing instead of listening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you keep the pen. Supervised listening. If I interrupt, write it down; we'll start with that.

mechanism: A improvises repair stages in response to B objections and appoints B supervisor while retaining authority to define the process.
confusable: D89 retrospectively reframes a rupture; D90 performs present repair expertise despite inventing each step.
comparison: A listening/pen adjustment differs from a biscuit process retroactively explaining B questions as stages.
seedUse: Retain D90-a rejected tea and rejected note-taking producing a named supervised-listening stage, with A assigning B the pen.
